create_learning_rate_schedule: create a learning rate schedule with linear warmup and cosine decay using optax
create_optimizer_adamw: create an adamw or adarows optimizer with weight decay masking and learning rate schedule
create_train_state: create an initial partitioned training state with optimizer and model variables for distributed training
init_model_shapes: initialize and evaluate model parameter shapes without computing actual values using jax eval_shape
init_model_variables: initialize model variables by calling model init with a PRNG key and input batch
